section_summary.extract_value: This section, an abstract, describes a single study (Study X) conducted with 261 college students (60.9% female, mean age 20.16 years) from the northeastern United States. The study investigated associations between body appreciation and self-enhancement/self-expression correlates, finding that higher body appreciation was linked to a greater need for uniqueness and investment in appearance, particularly among African Americans/Blacks, but not to interest in cosmetic enhancements.
